page.overview:
What is Bertie Bott?

Bertie Bott (b. 1935) was a wizarding confectioner, who accidentally created Bertie Bott's Every Flavour Beans. For this, he was featured on a Chocolate Frog Card.

Bott was born in the year 1935, somewhere in Great Britain.

During years of his life, Bott dedicated himself to confectionary and sweets production. One day, in the mid-20th century, Bott made a mistake that would make him famous: while trying to create tasty sweets from food, a pair of dirty socks were accidentally included in the experiment. Recognising the sales potential of sweets that presented "a risk with every mouthful", Bott started commercialising them under the name Bertie Bott's Every Flavour Beans. For the invention of these famous sweets, Bott is featured on a Chocolate Frog Card.

In the 1993–1994 school year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, a portrait of him guarded a secret room; the password to enter was "Bibble".
